 Bihar Board extends Class 9, 11 registration deadline for 2028 exams to November 6
 Bihar Board extends Class 9, 11 registration deadline for 2028 exams to November 6
 Vishnukumar V | October 25, 2026 | 01:31 PM IST | 2 mins read
 Schools can register students who missed the earlier deadline for the Bihar Board Intermediate and Matric annual examinations 2028 through the official websites.
 Bihar Board extends Class 9 and 11 registration deadline for 2028 exams. (Representative Image: Pexels) The Bihar School Examination Board (BSEB) has extended the registration deadline for the Intermediate and Matric annual examinations 2028 to November 6, 2026. The registration window, which was scheduled to close on October 25, has been extended to provide another opportunity to register students who missed the earlier deadline.
 According to the board’s press note, school heads can complete the registration process for eligible students of Class 11 for the Intermediate examination and Class 9 for the Matric examination through the respective official websites.
 Bihar Board Registration: Official websites
 School heads must use their user ID and password to register the students who have not yet completed the process.

 The board has asked educational institutions to complete the registration process within the extended deadline. Students who have already been registered do not need to register again.

 Steps to register for Bihar Board exams 2028
 According to the official Bihar School Examination Board (BSEB) websites, school heads can register students who missed the earlier deadline using their institutional login credentials. 
 For Intermediate Annual Examination 2028 (Class 11): 
 Visit the official website, intermediate.biharboardonline.com.
 Log in using the school’s user ID and password.
 Enter the captcha displayed on the login page.
 Follow the portal’s instructions to complete registration for eligible students who were left out.
 Verify the details and complete the registration process as directed on the website.
 For Matric Annual Examination 2028 (Class 9): 
 Visit the official website: secondary.biharboardonline.org.
 Open the registration link for the Matric Annual Examination 2028.
 Log in using the institution’s user ID and password.
 Follow the instructions on the portal to register eligible students who have not yet been registered.
 Verify the details and complete the process as directed on the website.
 The extension applies to the registration process for the Bihar Board Intermediate and Matric annual examinations scheduled for 2028. Students should contact their respective schools for assistance with registration and related formalities.
